claims.claim: The canary (1.1) returned 10 HTTP 5xx responses while stable (1.0) returned 0 over the same test.
All canary 5xx responses were on /checkout: 10 of 483 canary checkout requests (2.07%) versus 0 of 1455 stable checkout requests.
The canary 5xx responses occur in every 30 s window of the test (1, 3, 3, 3), not only at startup.
Canary latency is not worse than stable: the canary overall p95 is within 5 ms of the stable overall p95.
